description: Integrate Rust SDK Swift bindings into Xcode project. Link UniFFI-generated Swift bindings, compile Rust SDK for iOS/tvOS targets (aarch64-apple-ios, aarch64-apple-tvos, x86_64-apple-ios-sim). Set up dependency injection for Rust SDK modules. Implement async/await Swift wrappers around Rust SDK APIs. Test compilation and basic SDK calls.
title: Phase 3.2: iOS Rust SDK Swift Bindings Integration
